pairs.registryProposal: The golden path allows a deliberate ledger-less replay, while idempotent-steps says the ledger is always required and transactional-ddl requires the version bump inside each step. Spell which of those clauses a priced replay design suspends, or a deliberate single-script chain is scored as missing a bump it was told not to keep.
